verdict.rationale: A direct probe got HTTP 200 at https://sam.gov/robots.txt and found a standard published crawl policy under which content paths are crawlable by a keyless agent. That means an agent can check what it may read before fetching anything. Missing for 10: the specific directives (allow/disallow rules, sitemap references) are not itemized, and robots.txt on the API and docs hosts (api.sam.gov, open.gsa.gov) is unverified.
